name: Deportivo La Coruna
identity_summary: A Coruna's blue-and-white club: Super Depor glory, then a long fall, still civic and Galician.
source_quality_notes: Club history dates the side to 1906 / Sala Calvet (rcdeportivo.es). 1999-2000 league title is an era, not a standing winning identity, so H1 is 5 for the rise and fall. Galician derby with Celta.

name: Elche
identity_summary: A provincial club from Elche, local in scale, without a strongly documented football ideology.
source_quality_notes: Founded 10 Jan 1923 as Elche Foot-ball Club. Civic Alicante identity is the safe move. Regional rivalries exist; none are locked as must-exclude in this set.

name: Espanyol
identity_summary: Barcelona's other club, founded as a Spanish side in a city that already had a giant.
source_quality_notes: Founded 28 Oct 1900 as Sociedad Espanola de Football, the first club in Spain formed only by Spanish members (Wikipedia). Derby with Barcelona is the identity marker. Playing ideology not distinctive enough to leave 4.

name: Getafe
identity_summary: A young suburban Madrid club. Enduring identity is local and recent, not historic.
source_quality_notes: Present club founded 8 Jul 1983. Earlier Getafe sides existed; this entity is modern. Pragmatic recent coaching ignored. S2 at 2 is the one safe read: a late-founded top-flight club, not a custodian of ritual.

name: Levante
identity_summary: Valencia's older neighbourhood club, the Granotes, civic before they were famous.
source_quality_notes: Founded 6 Sep 1909; older than Valencia CF. Merged with Gimnastico in 1939 (Wikipedia). Derby with Valencia. Neighbourhood/civic identity is documented. Playing style not locked.

name: Malaga
identity_summary: Malaga's civic club. Recent foreign-money years are an era, not the identity.
source_quality_notes: Current entity from CA Malagueno, 25 May 1948; older CD Malaga lineage exists. 2010s Champions League run ignored as ownership era. Stay near 4 except city.

name: Osasuna
identity_summary: Pamplona's member-owned club. The name means health, and the members still own it.
source_quality_notes: Founded 24 Oct 1920. Official bylaws: still a member-owned club, not a SAD (osasuna.es). Name is Basque for health. This is one of the clearest civic/member identities in the batch.

name: Racing Santander
identity_summary: Santander's green-and-white club, a founding La Liga side and a Cantabrian civic team.
source_quality_notes: Founded 1913; one of the ten founding La Liga clubs (Wikipedia). Civic Cantabria is the safe read. Current division ignored.

name: Rayo Vallecano
identity_summary: Vallecas before Madrid. A neighbourhood club whose support is the point, not the trophies.
source_quality_notes: Founded 1924. Identity is the Vallecas district, not the wider city. Working-class and outsider character is widely documented in Spanish football writing. Playing style left at 4. Do not invent specific chants.

name: Real Betis
identity_summary: Seville's people's club. The saying is to love Betis even when they lose.
source_quality_notes: Official: founded 12 Sep 1907 (realbetisbalompie.es). Derby with Sevilla. 'Viva el Betis manque pierda' is the documented supporter line: journey over winning. That is why H1/H4 move off 4.

name: Real Sociedad
identity_summary: San Sebastian's Basque club, still defined by Zubieta and the city more than by buying stars.
source_quality_notes: Official: founded 7 Sep 1909 (realsociedad.eus). Basque civic identity and academy pathway are documented. Basque-only signing ended in 1989, so M4 is 5 not 7. Derby with Athletic. M1 at 5 is a light style read, confidence 1.

name: Sevilla
identity_summary: Seville's older club. A city aristocrat that expects to matter, not a neighbourhood cause.
source_quality_notes: Official: founded 25 Jan 1890, oldest club in the city (sevillafc.es). Derby with Betis. Europa League run is an era, so H1 is 3 not 1. Establishment read is against Betis as the people's club.

name: Valencia
identity_summary: Valencia's giant: Mestalla, the bat, a city club that once expected Europe as normal.
source_quality_notes: Founded 1919. Mestalla and the bat are the civic marks. Recent financial chaos ignored as ownership era; H1 stays 4 because the enduring story is a big club, not a suffering cult. Derby with Levante.

name: Villarreal
identity_summary: A small-town Yellow Submarine that reached Europe from a ceramic town, not a capital.
source_quality_notes: Founded 10 Mar 1923. Small-town distinction is the safe move. Academy/development is known but thinner than Freiburg or Atalanta, so M3 is 5 with confidence 1. Current European runs ignored as form.

name: RB Leipzig
identity_summary: A 2009 Red Bull project built to reach the top fast, not a century-old civic club.
source_quality_notes: Founded 19 May 2009 after Red Bull bought SSV Markranstadt's playing rights (Wikipedia). A modern project, not a civic century. Stay off the cartoon poles: not a 1 on every global/modern axis. Fan hostility is context, not a rebel score for the club itself.

name: VfB Stuttgart
identity_summary: Stuttgart's Swabian club, known for a long youth pathway as much as for the first team.
source_quality_notes: Founded 9 Sep 1893 (RSSSF). Official youth concept claims the most German youth titles and a long list of graduates (vfb.de). Civic Swabia plus academy are the safe moves. Current table ignored.

name: TSG Hoffenheim
identity_summary: A village club lifted into the Bundesliga by one backer, modern more than traditional.
source_quality_notes: Turn- und Sportgemeinschaft dated 1 Jul 1899; football rise is the Dietmar Hopp era (club facts page). Village scale plus privately funded modernity are documented. Do not invent a rebel identity. The club is the project, not the protest.

name: Bayer Leverkusen
identity_summary: The Werkself: a Bayer works team with a long academy, long known for coming close.
source_quality_notes: Founded 15 Jun 1904 (RSSSF). Works-team / company-club identity is the name. Youth work at Kurtekotten is club-documented (bayer04.de). Neverkusen almost-identity is historical, so H1 is 5 not 7. 2024 title ignored as current era.

name: SC Freiburg
identity_summary: A development club that built a football school to stay in the Bundesliga without buying the table.
source_quality_notes: Founded 30 May 1904. Official football-school philosophy: one of the first German clubs to position as a development club in the late 1990s (scfreiburg.com). This is the clearest M3/S4 German identity in the batch.

name: Eintracht Frankfurt
identity_summary: Frankfurt's eagle club. The city and the noise come first; trophies are rarer than belonging.
source_quality_notes: Founded 1 May 1899 (RSSSF). Civic Frankfurt and a loud support culture are the documented marks. 2022 Europa League ignored as a season. H2 at 6 is the volatile matchday read, confidence 2.
